faultsByCategory.descriptiveName: A Status Code The Document Does Not Declare
faultsByCategory.label: F920:A Status Code The Document Does Not Declare
faultsByCategory.title: Undeclared status code
faultsByCategory.advice: declare the status code for the operation in the document, or stop the API answering it

faultsByCategory.label: F100:HTTP Status 500
faultsByCategory.title: Internal server error
faultsByCategory.advice: look in the API's log for what failed while it handled the request; the document is not what to fix

faultsByCategory.descriptiveName: A Content Type The Document Does Not Declare
faultsByCategory.label: F921:A Content Type The Document Does Not Declare
faultsByCategory.title: Undeclared content type
faultsByCategory.advice: declare the content type for that status code in the document, or have the API send the one declared

faultsByCategory.descriptiveName: Schema Violation: Received A Response From API With A Structure/Data That Is Not Matching Its Schema
faultsByCategory.label: F200:Schema Violation: Received A Response From API With A Structure/Data That Is Not Matching Its Schema
faultsByCategory.title: Reply off schema
faultsByCategory.advice: the API and its document disagree about the reply's body: compare the places listed with the document, and fix whichever is wrong

faultsByCategory.descriptiveName: Received Success Response When Sending Wrong Data
faultsByCategory.label: F206:Received Success Response When Sending Wrong Data
faultsByCategory.title: Invalid data accepted
faultsByCategory.advice: make the API refuse what its document forbids; where the document forbids more than the API should, loosen the document instead
